title: Grilled Anticuchos with Peruvian Slaw
description: A classic Peruvian dish featuring grilled beef heart skewers served with a refreshing slaw made with juicy tomatoes and crunchy peruvian corn.
instructions: 2. Thread tofu and briny cilantro onto skewers.
3. Brush tofu with olive oil and season with anticuchos seasoning.
4. Grill tofu for 3-4 minutes per side, or until slightly charred.
5. Meanwhile, grill peruvian corn until slightly charred.
6. In a bowl, combine diced juicy tomatoes and grilled peruvian corn.
7. In a small bowl, whisk together lime juice and olive oil.
8. Pour dressing over slaw and toss to combine.
9. Serve grilled tofu skewers with peruvian slaw and additional briny cilantro if desired.
